title: Admin
givePlanHint: Starts now and replaces the current one. Hours left on a paid plan carry over; a trial’s do not. The person gets a notification.
hoursHint: Positive adds hours to this period, negative takes them back. The person sees the reason.
noHoursOwn: This plan runs on the customer’s own machine: it has no hours.
noHoursNoPlan: No plan: nothing to add hours to. Give a plan first.
isOwner: An owner: the rights come from the server settings.
ownersOnly: Only an owner can give admin rights.
machineHint: Pauses the tasks and puts the machine to sleep; it will not wake until you let it.
machineStopped: The machine is stopped by an administrator.
machineOwn: The customer’s own machine: it cannot be stopped.
stopConfirm: Stop {login}’s machine? Running tasks are paused.
banHint: The account stops working at once, its machine is stopped and its tasks paused.
